Tennis: drop feeds FH/BH ×20, rally target 15

days.name: Land Like a Cat
blocks: Animal walk medley: bear, crab, monkey, flamingo, giraffe, 10m each. Then 10 skips.

Stick landing from the ground. Jump up, land in <q>cat position</q>: feet quiet, knees over toes, chest up, hands out front. Freeze 3 seconds. 10 reps, Dad scores each 1 to 3 for quiet. Then 10 from a curb or bottom step.
Bunny hops over a chalk line. Hands on the line, kick both feet over to the other side, land feet together. 10 each direction. <q>Arms straight, look at your hands.</q>
Silent Landings. 10 jumps off the step. Count how many make no sound. Write the number on the chart. Again Friday.
Skateboard cruise or bike. Nothing timed.
days.dad: Gym already loaded him. Zero sprinting and zero jumping for distance today. Watch the knees on landing: if they cave inward, lower the step. Step no higher than his knee.

days.name: Test Day 1: Hands & Arms
blocks: Skips, big and small arm circles, bear crawl 2×10m, inchworms ×5.
Best of 2, 2 min rest between. Straight arms, thumbs around the bar. Record seconds.
Tennis ball, from a step. 3 throws right, 3 throws left. Mark the best with a cone, pace it. Record both arms.
Consecutive singles without a miss. Best of 3. Record.
Each leg, eyes open, arms out, up to 60s. Record each leg (skill unlock, not a battery item).
Riverside traveling rings. Hang and swing ×5. Then reach for the next ring with Dad spotting the hips. Goal: 3 passes. If he gets 3, try for 5.
Basketball court. HORSE, Dad shoots from one spot.
days.dad: Tests before rings, while he is fresh. Full rest between throws; these are max efforts. Cheer the effort, record the number without commentary. The non-dominant arm will look bad. That is the point: it is the one that will move most this year. Swim class after is recovery, add nothing.

days.name: Test Day 2: Fast & Far
blocks: A-march 2×15m, skips 2×15m, gallops each lead 2×15m, high knees 2×10m. Then 3 build-up runs over 20m at 60, 70, 80%.
Standing start behind a line, Dad at 20m with the phone timer: <q>ready, set, go</q>. 3 trials, walk-back rest of 2 min. Record best.
Toes behind the line, arm swing, jump, must stick the landing to count. 3 trials. Measure to the back heel. Record best.
Each leg, 2 trials, stick the landing on the same leg. Record both.
Cones at 0 and 5m. Sprint out, touch, back, touch, out. 2 trials. Record best.
Ready position and split step. Feet wider than shoulders, knees soft, hands ready. Dad claps, Teddy does a tiny hop-and-land, then points where Dad points. 15 reps. <q>Land ready.</q>
Bear walk 2×15m, crab walk 2×10m, 2 dead hangs.
Beat Dad's Broad Jump. Dad jumps from kneeling. Teddy tries to beat the mark from standing. Best of 3.
Soccer field. Roll-out sharks and minnows: Dad is the stationary shark, rolling balls to tag. Then free kicking.
Walk a lap, calves on the wall, one thing he did well.
days.dad: High-intent efforts today: 3 sprints, 3 jumps, 4 hops, 2 shuttles, 3 challenge jumps, about 15. That is the week's load spike, by design. If he is flat on the third sprint, take the best of two and move on.

days.name: Wall & Ball
blocks: Animal medley, skips, then 10 shadow forehands and 10 shadow backhands with a full unit turn.

Cartwheel step 2: <q>hand, hand, foot, foot</q>. Chalk a line. Lunge, reach hand then hand onto the line, kick one foot over then the other, land on the line. 8 each side. Then 10 donkey kicks against the wall.
Step-and-throw at a big chalk square on the tennis wall. Opposite foot steps forward. 15 throws dominant, 10 non-dominant. Score the hits.

Drop-feed forehands ×20: unit turn, contact in front, finish over the shoulder. Drop-feed backhands ×20. Wall rally: how many in a row? Then Test: rally count with Dad, cooperative, current ball, best of 3. Record.
Wall Rally Streak. Longest unbroken streak against the wall. Record.
Basketball. Dribble tag with Dad stationary and a ball to roll, then HORSE.
days.dad: Form over volume. If the finish starts dropping, stop the set at 10, not 20. Tennis is cooperative today so high-intent efforts stay near zero. Keep them there.

days.name: Skate & Stick
blocks: Free skate. One 5-minute safe-fall lesson: bend the knees, roll onto the side and forearm, never straight arms. Practice from kneeling on grass ×5.
Single-leg stick. Small hop forward, land on one leg, statue for 3 seconds. 5 each leg. Then hop sideways ×5 each.
Jump rope, 2 rounds of 2 minutes. <q>Tiny hops, wrists not arms.</q>
Silent Landings, round 2. 10 jumps off Monday's step. Beat Monday's number.
Soccer field kickaround and passing games. No sprint races today.
Calves, hamstrings. Ask: <q>what was your best thing this week?</q>
days.dad: Saturday is roughly 5 hours of organized sport. Today is balance and skill, high-intent efforts 5 or fewer. Early bed, big dinner, water bottle ready for tomorrow.

days.name: Soccer · Lacrosse · Tennis
blocks: Walk, calves against the wall, 3 slow breaths.
days.dad: Highest-load day of the week. Watch for heel or knee complaints Sunday morning. If there are any, Sunday's card becomes stretching only and you tell me.

days.name: Ceremony
blocks: Cartwheel step 1 again: bunny hops over a line ×10. Compare with Monday.
Sit down with the test sheet. Read every number to Teddy. Draw the Cub rank card with seven empty patch slots. Ask him which patch he wants first.
days.dad: This is the ceremony moment. The numbers are his, the card is his. Next week's theme is Stick It.
